name: A Vine on a House
source:
I recently read a little story written by Ambrose Bierce in 1905 about creeping vine on a forgotten house. I was surprised to discover the uncanny resemblance shared between Ambrose's house with an abandoned house that my mother and I explored a couple of years back--down to its very location (somewhere between Missouri and Iowa). Just like the story, our house had its own mysterious vine that claimed it as its own.

[From [url=https://outgrabe.itch.io/avineonahouse]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我最近读了安布罗斯·比尔斯 (Ambrose Bierce) 于1905年写的一个小故事，讲述的是一座被遗忘的房子上爬行的藤蔓。我惊讶地发现安布罗斯的房子与几年前我和母亲探索过的一栋废弃的房子有惊人的相似之处——直到它的位置（密苏里州和爱荷华州之间的某个地方）。就像故事一样，我们的房子有自己的神秘藤蔓，声称它是自己的。

[来自[url=https://outgrabe.itch.io/avineonahouse]itch.io[/url]]
